name: Probing Strikes
text: Arrivals: coastal cities. The Militarist tests the lines: it builds and spreads as usual.

name: Factory Drive
text: Arrivals: industrial zones. Factories next to clean cities build 1 too.

name: Long Patrols
text: Arrivals: research stations. Spread reaches 1 hex further.

name: War Drums
text: Arrivals: each country's first base. Sway 1 toward Discord.

name: Mobilisation
text: Arrivals: coastal cities. Each corrupted city builds 1 more. Escalation: each country's first base gains an adversary ambassador when this round builds.

name: Station Raids
text: Arrivals: research stations. Each corrupted research station builds 1. Escalation: each country's first base gains an adversary ambassador when this round builds.

name: Fifth Column
text: Arrivals: coastal cities. Cities corrupt at 1 fewer ambassador. Escalation: each country's first base gains an adversary ambassador when this round builds.

name: Border War
text: Arrivals: each country's first base. This round is a war round. Escalation: each country's first base gains an adversary ambassador when this round builds; each player destroys a presence of theirs.

name: Supply Lines
text: Arrivals: industrial zones. Factories next to clean cities build 1 too. Escalation: each country's first base gains an adversary ambassador when this round builds.

name: Total Mobilisation
text: Arrivals: industrial zones. Each corrupted city builds 1 more, and factories next to clean cities build 1 too; sway 1 toward Discord; each player destroys 2 presence of theirs; 2 Sway leaves the Unity bucket.

name: Blitzkrieg
text: Arrivals: each country's first base. This round is a war round, and spread reaches 1 hex further; sway 1 toward Discord; each player destroys 2 presence of theirs; 2 Sway leaves the Unity bucket.

name: Occupation
text: Arrivals: research stations. Cities corrupt at 1 fewer ambassador, and each corrupted research station builds 1; sway 1 toward Discord; each player destroys 2 presence of theirs; 2 Sway leaves the Unity bucket.

name: Iron Doctrine
text: Arrivals: coastal cities. This round is a war round; sway 1 toward Discord; each player destroys 2 presence of theirs; 2 Sway leaves the Unity bucket.
